Updated 2026-09-28 with 69 original messages for change review, agent questions, permission rules, connectors, background runs, research progress and budgets. Placeholders and locale-specific plural forms are preserved; no upstream translated text was copied.

reviewer.evidence:
AI-assisted independent semantic review read all 1,315 Nepali messages across 12 slices for meaning, register, and script. Corrected English overflow, queue terminology, Boolean labels, artifact terminology, hue wording, URL grammar, and a misspelled object label; audited exact English-identical templates. This is not native-speaker certification. Updated 2026-09-28: an independent AI-assisted review checked all 69 added messages for meaning, UI register, terminology and placeholders, and corrected the catalog before this snapshot. The research-source count was checked against the pinned CLDR categories, including locale-specific decimal and non-singular forms. The complete 1,384-key snapshot was checked for key coverage, value kinds, placeholders and exact-English message paths; only individually justified new cognates, loanwords and technical names were retained. This increment does not claim a new linguistic review of all older messages, human review or native-speaker certification.

2026-09-29 incremental pollRefresh review: an AI-assisted bounded review checked this new action label for meaning, UI action wording and absence of placeholders or exact-English copy. This review covers only this addition, not prior catalog entries; no human or native-speaker certification is claimed.
